title: Answer Engine Product Visibility Lab
oneLiner: A GEO/AEO rehearsal bench that lets small e-commerce brands see whether AI answers mention their product, competitor, or nobody.
previewUrl: pending Stitch export in Phase B
targetUser: Niche Shopify and DTC operators whose sales depend on being named in AI shopping answers, buyer guides, and product comparisons.
keyUx: Enter product category, competitor names, proof claims, and buyer questions; the app simulates answer-engine queries, maps mention gaps, and outputs a claim/evidence patch list.
spread_trigger: A founder can screenshot the competitor mention matrix to a marketer or agency and demand a specific visibility fix.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called "Answer Engine Product Visibility Lab" for Niche Shopify and DTC operators whose sales depend on being named in AI shopping answers, buyer guides, and product comparisons.. The app is based on observed user pull from S4: E-commerce brands worry that AI-driven search and shopping answers fail to mention them, pushing a new visibility problem beyond classic SEO. S3: Commenters describe social listening and lead qualification as practical AI use, catching intent in Reddit, Quora, X, and niche forums. The app should use a Answer Rehearsal Lab around the trigger moment "Enter product category, competitor names, proof claims, and buyer questions; the app simulates answer-engine queries, maps mention gaps, and outputs a claim/evidence patch list." and make the first screen communicate "A GEO/AEO rehearsal bench that lets small e-commerce brands see whether AI answers mention their product, competitor, or nobody.". Build the core workflow around user-entered evidence and produce GEO patch list and AI-answer before/after card. Required sections: Query rehearsal wall; Competitor mention matrix; Missing proof checklist; Product claim evidence cards; FAQ/schema patch plan; Content brief queue; Before/after AI-answer preview. Emotional pressure to make visible: 역전. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with dark operator workspace, dense matrices, clear query states, and sharp orange action markers. Avoid generic dashboard framing; make the main interaction feel like Answer Rehearsal Lab.

sourceSignals.source: Business Insider on Lantern pivoting to e-commerce GEO/AEO
sourceSignals.evidence: E-commerce brands worry that AI-driven search and shopping answers fail to mention them, pushing a new visibility problem beyond classic SEO.
sourceSignals.action: Brands test LLM queries, compare competitor mentions, and seek fixes for answer-engine visibility.

sourceSignals.source: Reddit r/Entrepreneur discussion on real AI business use cases beyond hype
sourceSignals.evidence: Commenters describe social listening and lead qualification as practical AI use, catching intent in Reddit, Quora, X, and niche forums.
sourceSignals.action: Founders monitor communities for exact pain-language and manually qualify people at the moment of intent.
